name: Xandria
description: A siren of Theros who was once a human scholar from Meletis and refuses to eat humans.

description_citations.text: "Xandria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Phenax is strongly implied to have cursed Xandria, turning her into a siren after she fell in love with Ninis.
timeline.quote: It is also strongly implied that Phenax was the god behind the curse

citation.text: "Phenax", section "Silence of the Gods". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A god claims Ninis and curses Xandria, who is transformed into a siren trapped in the Siren Sea.
timeline.quote: She awoke on an island and transformed into a siren .

citation.text: "Xandria", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Xandria attacks the sirens to stop them feasting on shipwrecked men; they tear flesh from her in retaliation.
timeline.quote: each siren tore a peck of flesh from her body

citation.text: "Xandria", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Xandria finds the survivor Tolios, who tries to stab her; she sings and subdues him.
timeline.quote: Reflexively, she burst into song, halting his attack immediately.

citation.text: "Xandria", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Xandria bites Tolios's neck and eats him as the other sirens watch.
timeline.quote: His eyes blazed with ecstasy as she bit deeply into his neck.

citation.text: "Xandria", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: A woman strongly implied to have been transformed into a siren by Phenax's curse after falling in love with Ninis.
